Step11 discharges only the inner C-necessary supposition; outer NoPossibleNB remains through17 and is discharged18–20 only to possible Necessary Being. Source-situation admission, same-C preservation, EVER/now, class and actual-concrete causal guards remain distinct from PSR fact-reasons or Ontic.Causes. Sense 5 quantifies over the full supplied history; sense 8 additionally retains a fixed past cutoff, so no future-existence substitution is concealed. Both encode all-and-only content including the empty roster. This gives the roster component of original sense 2 a meaningful body; the original definition also contains counterfactual includes. Since strict accessible-world inclusion and selected closest-realization inclusion remain distinct unresolved alternatives, no complete binding or allowance deletion for original 2 is claimed. Original 3 remains ambiguous: senses 9-14 preserve population/member, first-occurrence, predecessor-transition and first-moment readings. BeginningReading enumerates these six options, BeginningCase gives their distinct bodies, and SelectedBeginning supplies one constructor plus that body. Exhaustiveness for a source use remains an explicit open application premise; constructors are exclusive reading choices, while predicate extensions can overlap. Integer onset witnesses overlap, rational onset separates first occurrence from predecessor, turnover separates member from population, and recurrence separates predecessor from first occurrence. Neither first occurrence nor predecessor transition forces the other; neither imposes a Nat or well-founded ontology. Original senses 1 and 4 retain the obtaining/same-situation, counterfactual, prior-partial-explanation and same-bearer causal-capability blockers recorded in the parked declaration audit.
